name: Scoring fixes

questions.text: How many columns does this dataset have in total (including the label column)?
How many feature columns are there, excluding the class/label column?
What is the name of the label/target column?
Are the feature columns (f1...f617) numeric or categorical?
How many samples belong to class 6?
Which class has the fewest samples, and how many?
Is the dataset perfectly class-balanced (same number of rows per class)?
What is the standard deviation of column f1?
What is the mean value of column f10?
What are the min and max values of column f100?
What are the min and max values of column f10?
What are the min and max values of column f617?
How many rows have a value of f1 greater than 0?
What is the Pearson correlation coefficient between f1 and f2?
What is the average value of f300 for rows in class 20?

config_changes: Call 2 falls back to tool result

notes.problem: Answer correctness was 20% although many answers were visibly right.
notes.root_cause: Number extraction matched digits inside column names (the 1 in f1), and a 0.0001 tolerance demanded 4+ decimal places.
notes.fix: Letter-boundary check in the number regex, tolerance loosened to 0.001, Call 2 falls back to the raw tool result when it fails.
notes.result: Correct answers now score as correct. Found next: columns 21-617 never reach the model's prompt.

config.schema_serialization: to_prompt_string() with THRESHOLD=20 truncation + dtype-grouped summary for remaining columns (KNOWN BUG: summary lines computed but never appended to output -- columns past 20 are fully invisible to the model, not just vaguely summarized)
config.tool_registration: generator.tools set explicitly in eval script to match production's per-request mutation
config.synthesis_call: fresh system+user messages, no tools/tool_choice passed, explicit no-tool/no-function-call instruction; wrapped in try/except with raw-tool-result fallback on synthesis failure (Groq's gpt-oss-20b can attempt an unprompted 'python' tool call even with no tools declared)
config.scoring: deterministic numeric/range/string match (via compute_golden_value using golden_pandas_code) with LLM-judge fallback for categorical/fuzzy answers; extract_number/extract_all_numbers now use a negative lookbehind to avoid matching digits embedded in column names
config.tolerance: 0.001 globally (raised from 0.0001 across all golden_dataset.json questions)
config.tracer: generate_with_tools()'s existing tracer hook now wired from the eval script, capturing per-question pandas_code and raw_tool_result alongside the final answer
